name: Sachan Shisui Kobura
desc:
Sachan Shisui Kobura is an Etrean NPC. She is the head of the Kobura Clan.

In an argument with the three other Sachans in [The Golden Rat](location:the_golden_rat), she held that the [Etrean Royalists](faction:etrean_royalists) needed to seek powerful allies to make the next move, namely [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority), and proposed to be the head of such an alliance. Shisui is often described as ambitious and selfish.
goals: Broker an alliance between Clan Kobura and [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority), with herself at its head
